title: The Warden of the Old Guard
description: Full Warden encounter with playstyle-variant dialogue. Three hundred years of guarding. Thirty-seven failed attempts. The record must be clear. FIX 2026-07-28 (cowir-ai msg-3206): this scene's hospitality beat was gated on a 'completionist' branch key that _detect_playstyle CAN NEVER RETURN (it returns automator/grinder/exploiter/manual/balanced only), so it had never played for any player. The beat is unconditional in canon — W1 ch.4 has the Warden offer the guardhouse food with no condition attached — so it is now the default arm rather than a playstyle reward. Playstyle-specific arms (e.g. grinder) are untouched and still take precedence.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: You are strong. Stronger than expected. The record does not account for this. It doesn't change anything. Step forward.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: There is food in the guardhouse. I cannot leave the post. But you may rest before we begin, if you wish.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: This pass has been held for three hundred years. By my count, you are the thirty-seventh party to attempt it. The other thirty-six turned back.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: I am not telling you this to frighten you. I am telling you so the record is clear.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: Show me what you are, and I will show you what I have left.
